domain.name: The History of Arda

rules: Store dates in their NATIVE calendar only (valian_years, years_of_the_trees, first_age, second_age, third_age, fourth_age); never convert between calendars.
If the tradition is silent or vague, use precision circa/range or omit dating and put a human phrase in a label field. Do not guess precise years.
Entities: persons, peoples, places, objects, works-within-the-world (kind values: person, people, place, object, work_in_world).
